Sofia (People Ops): FYI team 1 - we've updated the Flexible Work & Coworking reimbursement section in the handbook. Need manager bulk ack + individual enrollments for optional coworking stipend by EOD next Friday. :bicycle:
Juno (Manager): Can you confirm who is eligible for the coworking stipend? Some of my team are fully remote in APAC.
Miles (HRBP): Eligibility: full-time employees with remote status who are not on an office-assigned desk. Part-timers prorated if 20+ hours/week. APAC eligibility mirrors NA/EU but local tax guidance applies. We'll add notes in the upload template.
Harpreet (Legal): Note on tax: stipends are taxable in certain jurisdictions. People Ops will flag users with local-tax implications in the export. We'll attach a vendor FAQ for managers.
Sofia (People Ops): Pasting CSV header for manager bulk uploads (one row per person): manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,remote_status,coworking_eligible,preferred_enroll_slot,notes
Sofia (People Ops): ```manager_email,employee_email,employment_type,team,timezone,remote_status,coworking_eligible,preferred_enroll_slot,notes```
Juno (Manager): For preferred_enroll_slot, are those coded values? My team is EMEA-heavy.
Sofia (People Ops): Use SLOT_A (09:00 PT), SLOT_B (13:00 PT), SLOT_C (19:00 PT). We'll map slots to local times on import. Put NOT_INTERESTED if they don't want stipend enrollment.
Juno (Manager): If someone opts in but later declines, do we have a cancel flow?
Miles (HRBP): Yes, employees can cancel via the benefits hub within 30 days of enrollment; managers can notify People Ops for retro cancels. We'll mark cancellation in the export.
Harpreet (Legal): If managers request exceptions for contractors, escalate with a written justification. Contractors generally not eligible unless contract specifies stipend.
compliance-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Flexible Work + Coworking stipend ack" will post at T-72 and T-24 before deadline.
Sofia (People Ops): Fallback for missed live Q&A: recorded FAQ + short quiz. For stipend processing we require the enrollment ack and confirmation that the employee completed the tax acknowledgement. Managers: please run the bulk upload and confirm DocuSign ack invites sent. I'll run the final export Monday morning.
Juno (Manager): Uploading now. Marked three APAC engineers with TAX_NOTE in notes.
Sofia (People Ops): Thanks. Export command I'll run: ```gsutil cp gs://redwood-ops/hr/flexible_cowork_exports_1978.csv ./flexible_cowork_exports_1978.csv```
Miles (HRBP): If any disputes about eligibility, label threads "policy-question" and cc Legal (Harpreet). We'll triage quickly.
Sofia (People Ops): Final: canned manager reminder and a short manager FAQ coming in 15m. Appreciate the quick turn on this! :raised_hands:
